root_causes: Android's retained provider owner transfer allowed only the same actor even after Gateway had committed an exact cross-actor reauthorization.

Child terminal cleanup and a new time attachment did not share an atomic reservation point; retries could also compare a confirmed-idle provider permit with the requested launch-pending game identity.
The current Playnite list was guarded by host UUID but not by the full host/profile actor key, allowing stale parent callbacks to reach child presentation and artwork paths.
changes: Added a one-shot exact retained provider transfer authorization created only after successful reauthorization commit.
Made child-terminal reservation, join, retry and new-attachment publication share one lock and preserved generation, actor epoch, execution profile, stream, app and process fences.
Required actor lease epoch on completed terminal receipt aliasing and represented confirmed-idle provider identity explicitly.
Moved unused allowance cleanup into ChildSessionClient so structured rejected starts never emit child end and ambiguous starts are status-resolved first.
Bound the active Playnite projection and all asynchronous render/artwork paths to exact HostProfileKey while retaining an explicit key for host-selection screensaver artwork.
